[[File:Moffpanakagift.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka's]] gift in [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] quarters onboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]].]]

This '''statue''' was a gift from [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] given to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The Emperor kept it among several other statues in his quarters while staying onboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].
